title: Finite lisse condition in intrinsic and fixed-module coordinates
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], Lambda a finite commutative ring, and M a module over its intrinsic constant ring sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose M is locally constant [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] and its stalk at every bounded geometric point is finite [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk]. Then the inverse of the canonical coefficient realization sends M to a locally constant fixed-Lambda module sheaf with finite geometric stalks.

source.place: Tag 0A3H, lemma-sections-upstairs; fixed-module coefficient transport by sites.tex Tag 00YV and proetale.tex Tag 099Y

proof.text: Restrict to the constant scalar unit. On each localized site the sheafification of the constant module presheaf is canonically the fixed-module constant sheaf after restricting scalars. The map induced by the module sheafification unit is locally bijective, hence invertible. This carries each intrinsic constant trivialization to a fixed-module trivialization. Geometric stalks have the same additive colimit after restriction; preservation of colimits by the forgetful functor identifies their underlying sets. Thus restriction sends M to a finite lisse fixed-module sheaf. This is the finite-local part of the existing constant-module constructibility argument.

source.place: Tag 0A3H, lemma-sections-upstairs; fixed-module coefficient transport by sites.tex Tag 00YV and proetale.tex Tag 099Y

proof.text: The sheafification unit at an already sheaf-valued fixed-module presheaf is invertible. Its components are linear over the constant scalars, and identify F with restriction of its intrinsic realization. Apply this to F equal to the inverse realization of M and compose with the realization counit. Transfer the finite constant models across this isomorphism. The existing finite-model local-constancy and stalk lemmas give the claimed conjunction.

theorem proEtale_intrinsic_lisse_fixed (S : Scheme.{u})
    (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (M : proEtaleRingModules S (proEtaleConstantRing S Λ))
    (hM : IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf S Λ M)
    (hfinite : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S),
      Finite ((finiteCoefficientModuleStalkFunctor y Λ).obj M)) :
    IsLisseProEtaleFixedModuleSheaf S (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)
      ((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence S Λ).inverse.obj M)
